en.headline: Police arrest four teenagers over viral Sai Wan Ho alley assault video
en.dek: Officers held four local boys aged 13 to 17 after footage showed a younger boy being punched and slapped in a back alley early Monday.
body: Hong Kong police said on Wednesday they had arrested four local boys aged between 13 and 17 in connection with an assault captured on video in a Sai Wan Ho back alley.

A police spokesman said officers noticed a clip circulating online that appeared to show a boy being attacked by four others with their hands at around 3am on Monday. The Eastern police district launched an investigation and made the arrests on Tuesday.

The four are suspected of inciting another person to become a member of an unlawful society and of assault occasioning actual bodily harm. All remain in custody for further inquiries, and the case has been handed to the district’s anti-triad unit.
According to police, the victim sustained only minor injuries and declined hospital treatment. The force is continuing its inquiries.

zh.headline: 西灣河後巷童黨欺凌片 警拘4名13至17歲男童
zh.dek: 警方表示，網上片段顯示一名男童周一凌晨約3時在西灣河後巷疑遭掌掰及推倒，東區警區隨後拘4名本地男童。
body: 警方周三表示，留意到網上流傳一段影片，顯示一名男童於本周一凌晨約3時在西灣河一條後巷內懷疑被4名男童用手襲擊。
東區警區主動展開調查，並於周二拘4名年齡介乎13至17歲的本地男童，涉嫌煽惑他人成為非法社團成員及襲擊致造成身體傷害。
警方指，所有被捕人現正被扣留調查，案件交由東區警區反三合會行動組跟進。據了解，傷者只有輕傷，拒絕送院。
警方呼籲市民如有相關資料，歡迎提供協助。
